mentions.name: SLASHPLAY
mentions.description: A Discord bot that spins up game servers on demand, aiming to make launching a game server for friends or fellow gamers as convenient as possible.
mentions.audience: Friends and fellow gamers who want to spin up a game server on demand.
mentions.source_excerpt: Im working on a Discord Bot that can spin up game servers on demand. We are two developers, me and my friend from uni. Its called SLASHPLAY (https://slashplay.gg) . We are trying to make it as convienient as possible to spin up a game server for friends or fellow gamers.
